name: SymbolicArena Core-50 and GT-Reservoir-664
description: A symbolic-regression evaluation benchmark built from a standardized ground-truth reservoir, a frozen Core-50 subset, algorithm hyperparameter manifests, and evaluation result summaries.
citation: Anonymous authors. SymbolicArena: A Unified Platform for Dynamic and Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Symbolic Regression. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track submission.

distribution.name: SymbolicArena_NeurIPS26_ED_full_dataset_payload.tar.zst
distribution.description: Compressed archive containing the full standardized SymbolicArena dataset payload: 793 dataset directories and standardized CSV splits, metadata.yaml files, and formula.py files. The archive expands to dataset-url-full-standardized/.

distribution.name: SymbolicArena_NeurIPS26_ED_full_dataset_payload.tar.zst.sha256
distribution.description: SHA256 checksum for the compressed full standardized dataset payload.

distribution.name: metadata/full_dataset_directory_manifest.csv
distribution.description: One row per standardized dataset directory included in the full dataset payload.

distribution.name: metadata/full_dataset_file_manifest.csv
distribution.description: One row per copied dataset file, including hosted path, file size, and SHA256 checksum.

distribution.name: metadata/core50_ground_truth_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Frozen Core-50 task manifest with dataset identity, source family, subgroup, target variable, feature names, and ground-truth expression.

distribution.name: metadata/core50_algorithm_hyperparameters_full.json
distribution.description: Machine-readable hyperparameter manifest for the 12 evaluated symbolic-regression algorithms.

distribution.name: data/
distribution.description: Standardized train, validation, ID test, and OOD test splits for benchmark tasks, stored under data/ in the compressed payload.

recordSet.name: Core-50 task records
recordSet.description: One record per frozen Core-50 benchmark task.

field.name: features
field.description: Ordered feature names used by the benchmark runner.

field.name: ground_truth_expression
field.description: Ground-truth symbolic expression for formula replay and symbolic-fidelity evaluation.

rai:dataCollection: The benchmark is assembled from public symbolic-regression formula sources and generated deterministic splits. See the paper sections on reservoir standardization and infrastructure/data cleaning.
rai:dataPreprocessing: Each task is normalized into train, validation, ID-test, and OOD-test splits with metadata, formula identity, target name, feature names, and source-family tags.
rai:useCases: Intended for evaluating symbolic-regression algorithms under a fixed Core-50 benchmark protocol, auditing OOD generalization, symbolic fidelity, efficiency, robustness, and stability.
rai:limitations: The benchmark is designed for symbolic-regression evaluation and should not be interpreted as a universal measure of all scientific discovery systems. The Core-50 subset is a compact evaluation subset distilled from a larger reservoir.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No human-subject or personally identifiable information is included in the benchmark tasks.
rai:maintenancePlan: During review, the anonymized OSF dataset page will remain accessible. After acceptance, the authors plan to replace anonymous review links with a public archival release, retain checksums for released files, and document any future benchmark updates through versioned manifests.
